note: Vectors for spec/dossier-v1.md §11. Every case starts from a real testnet dossier (`dossiers`: `base` unless the case names another), applies `patch` (RFC 6902 add/replace/remove; '/claims/-' appends), and is checked with the transactions it needs from fixtures/testnet/<txid>.hex: first those the claims name, then the previous transactions of the origins' transparent inputs. `txs` changes them: `omit` not supplied; `mempool` reported in the mempool ('all' for every one); `hex` replaces a transaction's hex; `heights: true` gives each its real height from `heights` (otherwise, as from a file, heights are unknown and every verified claim carries a detail saying inclusion was not checked). The check uses `expect_nonce` and `issued_at_height` when given. `expect` is the conformance outcome: exit (the CLI's: 0 all verified, 1 failed/unproven/problems, 2 only not_checked), all_verified, assurance, nk_proven, controlled, the statuses, problems, and the claims that did not verify with zeceipt's English summary (the wording is recorded for orientation; conformance is the rest). Parse cases record the error without serde's line/column. crates/zeceipt-core/tests/dossier_vectors.rs and packages/verify/test/dossier-vectors.mjs run every case; ZECEIPT_WRITE_VECTORS=1 on the Rust test rewrites `expect` from the code.
notes_note: From the live report of 2026-09-30 (testnet.zec.rocks). nullifier = DeriveNullifier_nk(note), computed from nk and the note opening alone; spent_in is the dossier's transaction whose actions carry that nullifier (absent: spent in none of them, so the note is not shown to be the holder's).

nullifier_key_filler.ak_is: the spend validating key of the Orchard spending key 0x07 repeated 32 times
nullifier_key_filler.rivk: the integer t+1 (32 bytes little-endian) for the first t in 0..7 that makes a valid full viewing key
